selection_basis: COBAR development pilots P1-P10 on streams 301-310 only (docs/cobar/07_pilot_protocol.md)

streams.generator: full job shop, durations U[5,50], default delta weights, severity medium

S7_benchmarks.streams: 34 published bases (ta01-20, dmu01-05, swv01-05, yn1-4) x stream seed 901; unit = base instance

settings_S4_to_S7: secondary; run in this order after S1-S3; every setting that is run is reported whatever it shows
primary_endpoint: stream mean of pi over steps 1..10 and solver seeds, shared z* per physical instance

criteria.primary_target: candidate vs iaip_sr in S1: mean PI reduction >= 5%, stream-bootstrap 95% CI upper bound < 0, Holm p < 0.05
criteria.stronger_target: candidate vs portfolio_hinted in S1: reduction >= 10%, CI upper bound < 0
criteria.location_matters: candidate vs random_rounds in S1: CI upper bound < 0
criteria.non_inferiority: S2 and S3: upper 95% CI bound of mean(candidate - iaip_sr) < 0.05 * mean(iaip_sr)
criteria.no_final_gap_regression: S1: gap_B CI lower bound <= 0 or mean diff <= 0

classification.GO: primary target, stronger target, location_matters, non-inferiority in S2 and S3, validated, no gap regression, AND a component credited to a new mechanism
classification.CONDITIONAL_GO: the performance criteria hold, but the credited mechanism is not new (e.g. critical-path-seeded rounds), or the certificate adds no measurable value
